column1: # Released catalogue designs: slug <TAB> version <TAB> content fingerprint.
# Patterns are software releases. The fingerprint is CIR.fingerprint (the design content hash
# the release chain and the certificate's content hash are taken over, CIR.to_dict) with the
# version blanked, so it measures content alone. tests/test_release_versions.py fails when a
# design's fingerprint changes while its version does not.
# HOW TO UPDATE: when you change a design's content, bump that builder's default version
# (a new minor, e.g. 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0) AND update its row's version and fingerprint together in
# the same commit. Print the current rows with:
# Never update a fingerprint without bumping the version: that is exactly the change this
# table exists to refuse (a buyer's "1.0.0" and a new download's "1.0.0" being different).
# History: a8ed44f (FB3-G, D-FB-6) re-derived gauge and counts; every design whose content
# (LEGACY_HELD), pebble-raglan-cardigan-*, and the already-1.1.0 vessels and Cloudline.
